snippet.title: Madden NFL 08 - PC Gameplay (1080p60fps)
snippet.description:
Madden NFL 08 - PC Gameplay (1080p60fps).

Madden NFL 08 is an American football video game based on the NFL that was published by EA Sports and developed by EA Tiburon. It was released on August 14, 2007 for Xbox 360, Wii, PlayStation 3, PlayStation 2, Nintendo DS, PlayStation Portable, Xbox, GameCube, Microsoft Windows and for Mac in September 2007.
